Rescue [[Mei Ling]] from Crimson Skull bandits!

== Quest information ==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Mesmer
| primary = y
}}

=== Objectives ===
* Meet [[Lo Sha]] in [[Panjiang Peninsula]]. 
* Find out where the [[Crimson Skull]] are keeping [[Mei Ling]]. 
* Protect [[Lo Sha]] and help him rescue [[Mei Ling]]. 
* Talk to [[Lo Sha]]. 
* Return to [[Headmaster Kaa]] for your reward. 
=== Reward ===
* 2500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] 
* [[Gilded Artifact]] 
: [[Energy]] +7 (Req. 4 [[Fast Casting]]) 
: Halves skill recharge of [[Spells]] (Chance: 10%) 
: [[Health]] +15

== Walkthrough ==
{{section-stub}}
Head South into Panjiang Peninsula from [[Tsumei Village]] and follow the quest marker to Lo Sha. After talking to him follow the marker into the Crimson Skull camp and kill them. Talk to Lo Sha again once you have rescued Mei Ling. Map travel back to Shing Jea Monastery for the quest reward.

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
;Headmaster Kaa
:''"Listen closely: I understand that Lo Sha has recovered the legendary '''Box of Illusions'''. If this is true, then I must study it. I know not why he has not brought it to me already, prideful boy."''
:''"I believe '''Lo Sha''' is in '''Panjiang Peninsula'''. Will you find him and acquire the box for me?
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will find Lo Sha and retrieve the box.
| decline = I am not going to take on Lo Sha.
| ask = '''Lo Sha''' knows not what he has. I need you to retrieve that '''Box of Illusions''' from him so that I may study it carefully.
}}

=== Intermediate dialogue ===
;Lo Sha
:''"<Party leader>, I am so glad to see you. I have shamed myself and my order. I wanted to present the ornate box to Mei Ling, so I asked her to meet me. Meanwhile, I allowed some members of the Crimson Skull to learn of our rendezvous; I hoped to foil their ambush, protect Mei Ling, and earn her favor in the process. But the bandits came in such large numbers that I was unable to stop them. They have taken Mei Ling with them. I beg of you: help me to free Mei Ling. Lead the way and I shall help as best I can!"''

;Lo Sha
:''"We must free Mei Ling!"''

;Mei Ling
:''"Thank goodness you are here! These bandits ambushed me out of nowhere. Without you and the brave Lo Sha, I would not have survived."''

;Lo Sha
:''"Thank you so much for your help. If Headmaster Kaa wants the box, then he shall have it. It seems unimportant to me, now. I am just so grateful that Mei Ling is safe..."''

=== Reward dialogue ===
;Headmaster Kaa
:''"The Box of Illusions! So, it does exist after all. How beautiful it is! Thank you, <Character name>. Now that you have completed your advanced training, you should go see [[Master Togo]] again. You will find him in [[Linnok Courtyard]]."''

== Notes ==
{{anomaly|Although rescuing Mei Ling after Lo Sha dies will produce the message "Quest failed", after returning to the area the quest will update to the next "Talk to Lo Sha" step. After talking to him again you may return to Headmaster Kaa for the reward.}}
